blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.
blocks.zh: 时间序列语言模型(TSLMs)使得基于语言的理解和推理能够超越时间数据,然而一个根本问题仍然存在:它们的时间序列表达应保留哪些信息,它们应顾及哪些变化? 现有的TSLMs通常将语言模型暴露为单一的表示,在下游任务中施加了固定的导出偏差. 相反,我们采用了补充陈述作为时间序列推理的设计原则。 我们的模型结合了两种视觉观点:行地图保留了绝对测量和被观测到的坐标框架,而正常的延迟则嵌入了正振幅回升和抵消因素,同时暴露出时间结构. 专用可视化编码器通过可视化符号和多层次特征聚变,将两种观点整合为共享语言模型. 评价时间干预证实两种观点呈现出截然不同的不一致特征,而单一观点的浮出水面则表明,两者的结合在基本认知之外特别有益,在预测和推理方面大有收获。 我们的双视模型建于Quen3-VL-8B上,将TSR Bench的整体精度从单线地块的44.5%提高到53.2%,大大地超过了36.7%的经评价的最强专用TSLM基线。 它进一步在TSExam上实现了89.9%的精度,在多变量的ChatTS对齐上实现了86.8%的精度. 这些结果共同表明,互补表述为通用TSLMs提供了一个有效的设计原则,使模型能够利用时间结构而不牺牲对原始计量框架的利用。

blocks.en:
Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) seek to extend the reasoning and interaction capabilities of large language models to sequential data, enabling models to answer questions, infer temporal relationships, forecast future behavior, and support decisions over time series ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Langer et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . A central challenge in this emerging paradigm is how temporal signals should be represented to the language model. Existing approaches serialize numerical values into text, learn dedicated time-series embeddings, or project features from specialized temporal encoders into the language-model representation space ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Langer et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2026 ) . As summarized in Table 1 , these approaches typically commit to a single time-series representation, with absolute measurement scale either retained directly or provided separately as auxiliary metadata. Yet these representational choices impose fundamentally different inductive biases: representations that retain absolute amplitudes and coordinate information support quantitative readout, whereas normalized representations can suppress such information while emphasizing relative structure and temporal dynamics. Recent evaluations further show that simply rendering a time series as a line plot can already provide strong temporal understanding to general-purpose vision-language models ( Yu et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2024 ) , suggesting that representation—not only model scale or training strategy—is a key determinant of time-series reasoning ability. This motivates a more fundamental question: Can complementary representations improve
general-purpose time-series reasoning?
blocks.zh:
时序语言模型(TSLMs)寻求将大语言模型的推理和交互能力扩展至顺序数据,使模型能够回答问题,推断时间关系,预测未来行为,以及支持跨时间序列的决定(Xie等人,2025年;Langer等人,2026年;Guan等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年a). 这一新出现的范式的一个中心挑战是,应如何向语言模型反映时间信号。 现有方法将数值序列化成文字,学习专用时间序列嵌入,或从专门的时间编码器进入语言模型代表空间的项目特征(Xie等人,2025年;Langer等人,2026年;Guan等人,2026年)。 如表1所示,这些方法通常致力于单一时间序列的表示,绝对计量尺度要么直接保留,要么作为辅助元数据单独提供。 然而,这些代表性选择造成了根本不同的诱导性偏差:保留绝对振幅和协调信息支持定量读取的表示,而正常的表示可以压制这种信息,同时强调相对结构和时间动态。 最近的评估进一步表明,简单地将时间序列作为线性图谱,已经能够对通用视觉语言模型提供很强的时间理解(Yu等人,2026a;Cai等人,2024),这表明代表性——不仅仅是模型规模或培训战略——是时间序列推理能力的关键决定因素。 这引发了一个更根本的问题: 补充说明能否改进?
通用时间序列推理?

blocks.en: We hypothesize that general-purpose time-series reasoning benefits from exposing the model to complementary views of the same signal, each preserving different information and inducing different invariances. Rather than requiring a single representation to simultaneously retain all information relevant to downstream reasoning while suppressing nuisance variation, this formulation allows distinct views to provide different inductive biases. We instantiate this principle with two visual representations: a standard line plot and a normalized delay embedding. The line plot preserves absolute amplitudes, axis ranges, and measurement scales, providing the information required for questions grounded in observed values. In contrast, delay embeddings reconstruct a time series as a trajectory in phase space using time-lagged observations, revealing geometric structure associated with the underlying dynamics ( Takens, 2006 ) . We normalize this representation before rendering it as a two-dimensional view, thereby factoring out affine changes in amplitude while retaining the geometry of the temporal trajectory. Our central hypothesis is that combining these complementary views is particularly useful beyond basic perception, where reasoning, prediction, and decision-making require models to exploit temporal structure while remaining grounded in the observed measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,一般目的时间序列推理的好处是将模型暴露在同一个信号的补充观点中,每个信号保存不同的信息,并诱导不同的偏差。 这种提法不要求单一陈述同时保留与下游推理有关的所有信息,同时抑制扰动变化,而是允许不同的观点提供不同的诱导偏差。 我们用两种视觉表现来即时地描述这一原则:标准线条图案和正常的延迟嵌入. 该行图保存绝对振幅、轴距和测量尺度,提供基于观测值的问题所需的信息。 与此相反,延迟利用时间标记的观测结果将时间序列重建为相位空间的轨迹,揭示了与基本动态有关的几何结构(Takes,2006年)。 我们使这种表达方式正常化,然后把它作为二维视图,从而在保留时间轨迹几何的同时,考虑振幅的近似变化。 我们的中心假设是,把这些补充性观点结合起来,在基本认知之外特别有用,因为推理、预测和决策需要模型来利用时间结构,同时以观察到的测量为基础。

blocks.en:
Building on this representational principle, we design a dual-tower TSLM in which each visual view is processed by a dedicated encoder. We retain Qwen3-VL’s native vision encoder, initialized from SigLIP-2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , to process line plots, and introduce a dedicated DINOv3 encoder ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) for delay embeddings, allowing each view to develop a specialized visual representation before interacting with the language model. The resulting visual features are compressed into a compact set of tokens, 230 for the line plot and 64 for the delay embedding, and concatenated as input to the language model.
Beyond this input-level fusion, we adopt DeepStack ( Meng et al., 2024 ) to inject multi-level visual features into the early language-model layers, enabling the complementary representations to interact with language processing throughout the network.
This architecture provides a compact realization of our central hypothesis while retaining the distinct inductive biases of the two visual views.
blocks.zh:
基于这种代表原则,我们设计了双层TSLM,其中每个视觉视图都由一个专用编码器处理. 我们保留了从SigLIP-2(Tschannn等人,2025年)初始化的Qwen3-VL本地视觉编码器,处理线条图案,并引入了用于延迟嵌入的专用DINOv3编码器(Siméoni等人,2026年),允许每个视图在与语言模型互动之前开发专门的视觉表现. 由此产生的视觉特征被压缩成一组紧凑的代号,230用于线条图案,64用于延迟嵌入,并作为输入语言模型.
在这个输入级聚变之外,我们采用DeepStack(Meng等人,2024年),将多层次的视觉特征注入早期语言模型层,使互补的表示能够与整个网络的语言处理互动.
这种结构为我们的核心假设提供了一个紧凑的实现,同时保留了两种视觉观点的明显诱导偏差。

blocks.en: To test our representational hypothesis and evaluate the resulting dual-tower TSLM, we conduct experiments on TSRBench ( Yu et al., 2026a ) , TSExam ( Cai et al., 2024 ) , and ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . Built on Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , our model achieves 53.2% overall accuracy on TSRBench, substantially narrowing the gap to GPT-5 with text and visual input (55.6%) while surpassing the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM (36.7%). It also outperforms the compared general-purpose and specialized baselines on TSExam and ChatTS numerical alignment. To assess the contribution of the complementary view, we compare against a plot-only variant trained under the same setup. Adding the delay embedding raises overall TSRBench accuracy from 45.2% to 53.2%, an 8.0-percentage-point improvement, with gains in reasoning, prediction, and decision-making while leaving perception nearly unchanged. Controlled evaluation-time interventions further reveal distinct invariance profiles: the delay-only model maintains nearly unchanged accuracy under positive rescaling and offset shifts, whereas the plot-only model, whose representation retains the measurement frame, is substantially more sensitive to these transformations. Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 为了测试我们的代表假说并评价由此产生的双塔TSLM,我们用文字和视觉输入法对TSR Bench(Yu等人,2026年a),TSExam(Cai等人,2024年)和ChatTS(Xie等人,2025年)进行了实验。 我们的模式建立在Qun3-VL-8B(Bai等人,2025年)上,在TSR Bench上实现了53.2%的总精度,将差距大大缩小到GPT-5(55.6%),同时超过了最强的经评价的专门TSLM(36.7%)。 它还超过了TSExam和ChatTS数字比对的通用基线和专门基线。 为了评估补充观点的贡献,我们比较了在同一结构下培训的仅图的变体。 加上嵌入延迟,TSR Bench的总体精度从45.2%提高到53.2%,提高了8.0%的精度,在推理、预测和决策方面有所进步,同时使感知几乎保持不变。 受控制的评价-时间干预进一步揭示出不同的差异性特征:仅限延迟模式在正缩放和抵消变化时保持几乎不变的准确性,而仅限图的模型(其表述保留了计量框架)则对这些转变更为敏感。 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • Complementary representations for time-series reasoning. We establish complementary representation as a design principle for TSLMs, motivated by the observation that quantitative readout requires the original measurement frame, whereas reasoning about temporal dynamics benefits from factoring it out. • A dual-view time-series language model. We propose a dual-tower architecture that combines line plots and normalized delay embeddings within a shared language model. Dedicated visual encoders, compact visual tokens, and multi-level feature fusion integrate temporal structure with the original measurement frame. • State-of-the-art TSLM performance. With an 8B backbone, our model outperforms all evaluated dedicated TSLMs on TSRBench, achieving 53.2% accuracy versus 36.7% for the strongest baseline. It also leads the evaluated models on TSExam and multivariate ChatTS numerical alignment, achieving 89.9% and 86.8% accuracy, respectively.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Time series admit multiple representations that expose different properties of the underlying signal. Beyond the raw sequential domain, classical approaches transform temporal observations into alternative coordinate systems, including frequency and time-frequency representations, recurrence-based representations, and delay embeddings that reconstruct trajectories in phase space ( Takens, 2006 ) . A related line of work represents time series as images, enabling spatial models to operate on temporal structure. Wang and Oates (2015) introduced Gramian Angular Fields and Markov Transition Fields for encoding temporal sequences as two-dimensional images, demonstrating their utility for classification and imputation. More recently, Naiman et al. (2024) showed that image transformations based on delay embeddings and short-time Fourier transforms can provide effective interfaces between time series and modern vision-based diffusion models, supporting generation across both short and long sequences. Collectively, these works demonstrate that alternative representations can expose useful and distinct structure in temporal signals. Our work builds on this perspective but shifts the focus from selecting a representation for a particular predictive or generative task to combining complementary representations for general-purpose time-series reasoning : we jointly expose the model to views designed to retain different information and induce different invariances.
blocks.zh: 时间序列承认多种表达,暴露了基础信号的不同属性. 除了原始的顺序域外,古典方法将时间观测转化为替代坐标系统,包括频率和时间频率表示、基于重复的表示以及延迟嵌入重建阶段空间轨迹(Takes,2006年)。 一个相关的工作线代表时间序列作为图像,使空间模型能够在时间结构上运行. Wang和Oates(2015年)将Gramian Angular Fields和Markov Transition Fields用于编码时间序列作为二维图像,显示了它们对分类和估算的效用. 最近,Naiman等人(2024年)显示,基于延迟嵌入和短时间Fourier变换的图像转换能够提供时间序列和基于现代视觉的传播模型之间的有效接口,支持跨越短序列和长序列的生成. 这些著作集体地表明,替代表述可能暴露出时间信号中有用和独特的结构。 我们的工作以这一角度为基础,但将重点从选择特定预测性或遗传性任务的代表转向将通用时间序列推理的补充代表结合起来:我们共同将模型暴露为旨在保留不同信息并诱发不同偏差的观点。

blocks.en: A growing body of work investigates how pretrained language models can be adapted to temporal data. Early approaches primarily focused on forecasting, either by serializing numerical observations as text ( Gruver et al., 2023 ) , prompting language models with textual descriptions of temporal sequences ( Xue and Salim, 2023 ) , or aligning and reprogramming time-series representations to exploit pretrained language-model representations ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) . More recent work has broadened this paradigm from task-specific prediction toward Time Series Language Models that accept time series as a modality and support natural-language understanding and reasoning. ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2025 ) aligns learned time-series embeddings with an LLM through instruction tuning, while OpenTSLM ( Langer et al., 2026 ) investigates both soft-prompt and cross-attention interfaces for reasoning over multivariate temporal signals. TimeOmni-1 ( Guan et al., 2026 ) instead represents numerical sequences directly within the language-model token space and targets complex temporal reasoning, whereas TS-Reasoner ( Yu et al., 2026b ) aligns representations from a pretrained time-series foundation model with an LLM. In parallel, benchmark studies have shown that general-purpose vision-language models can reason surprisingly effectively over time series presented as line plots ( Cai et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) , providing an alternative to explicitly learned time-series interfaces. Despite these diverse strategies, existing TSLMs predominantly expose the language model to a single primary representation of each temporal signal. Our work instead treats representation as a source of complementary inductive biases, jointly providing views that deliberately preserve different information and exhibit different invariances.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作研究了预先训练的语言模型如何能够适应时间数据. 早期的方法主要侧重于预测,要么将数值观测作为文本进行序列化(Gruver等人,2023年),促使语言模型对时间序列进行文字描述(薛和萨利姆,2023年),要么调整和重新编排时间序列表述,以利用预先训练的语言模型表述(周等人,2023年;孙等人,2024年;龚等人,2024年). 最近的工作将这一范式从针对特定任务的预测扩大到接受时间序列为模式并支持自然语言理解和推理的时代系列语言模型. ChatTS(Xie等人,2025年)通过指令调试,将学习到的时间序列嵌入器与LLM对齐,而OpenTSLM(Langer等人,2026年)则调查软速率和交叉意向接口,以对多变的时间信号进行推理. TimeOmni-1(Guan等人,2026年)而是直接代表语言模型符号空间内的数值序列,并瞄准复杂的时间推理,而TS-Reasoner(Yu等人,2026年b)则将预修时间序列基础模型中的表示与LLM相配合. 与此同时,基准研究表明,普通用途视觉语言模型在作为线条图列出的时间序列中可以令人惊讶地有效地说明理由(Cai等人,2024年;Yu等人,2026年a年),为明确学习的时间序列接口提供了一种替代办法。 尽管有这些不同的战略,但现有的TSLMs主要将语言模型暴露为每个时间信号的单一主要代表. 相反,我们的工作将代表性视为辅助性诱导性偏见的根源,共同提出有意保存不同信息并表现出不同偏差的观点。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出和概述

blocks.en:
Let Q Q denote a natural-language query and 𝒳 = { 𝐱 1 , … , 𝐱 n } \mathcal{X}=\{\mathbf{x}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{x}_{n}\} a collection of n n input time series, where 𝐱 i = ( x i , 1 , … , x i , m i ) ∈ ℝ m i \mathbf{x}_{i}=(x_{i,1},\ldots,x_{i,m_{i}})\in\mathbb{R}^{m_{i}} may have a different length and numerical range. Given ( Q , 𝒳 ) (Q,\mathcal{X}) , a Time Series
Language Model (TSLM) generates a natural-language answer A = ( a 1 , … , a | A | ) A=(a_{1},\ldots,a_{|A|}) autoregressively: P ⁡ ( A ∣ Q , 𝒳 ) = ∏ j = 1 | A | P ⁡ ( a j ∣ a < j , Q , 𝒳 ) . P(A\mid Q,\mathcal{X})=\prod_{j=1}^{|A|}P(a_{j}\mid a_{<j},Q,\mathcal{X})\ . (1) Rather than encoding each 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} through a single representation, we construct two complementary visual views, 𝒱 ⁡ ( 𝐱 i ) = { V i plot , V i delay } \mathcal{V}(\mathbf{x}_{i})=\{V_{i}^{\mathrm{plot}},V_{i}^{\mathrm{delay}}\} . The line-plot view V i plot V_{i}^{\mathrm{plot}} retains the original numerical scale and measurement frame, whereas the normalized delay view V i delay V_{i}^{\mathrm{delay}} factors out affine amplitude variation and represents the signal through its local temporal trajectories. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the two views are processed by dedicated visual encoders and projected into a shared language-model representation space. Their visual tokens are jointly provided to a single Qwen3-VL-8B language-model backbone, with multi-level visual features additionally injected through DeepStack ( Meng et al., 2024 ) . The model is trained in two stages, first aligning the delay-embedding stream with the language model and subsequently instruction-tuning the language model for time-series reasoning.

blocks.en: 3.2 Complementary Visual Representations
blocks.zh: 3.2 补充视觉表现

blocks.en: Our representation design exposes each time series through two complementary views with different information-preserving properties. The first retains the original measurement frame through a standard line plot, while the second represents the series through overlapping temporal windows after removing its absolute amplitude and offset.
blocks.zh: 我们的表述设计通过两种具有不同信息保存特性的互补观点,揭示每个时序. 第一种通过标准线图保留原测量框架,第二种通过重叠的时间窗口在去除其绝对振幅和抵消后代表系列.

blocks.en: For each time series 𝐱 i = ( x i , 1 , … , x i , m i ) \mathbf{x}_{i}=(x_{i,1},\ldots,x_{i,m_{i}}) , we render the raw observations as a two-dimensional line plot without amplitude normalization (Figure 3(a) ). Consequently, the plot retains the original value range and its position within the coordinate system, including the numerical values displayed along the vertical axis. This representation therefore preserves information about absolute amplitudes and differences in scale that would be removed by per-series normalization. For multivariate inputs, each series is rendered as its own plot rather than overlaid, so series with different ranges keep their own measurement frames.

Delay embeddings ( Takens, 2006 ) describe a time series through its local histories: overlapping windows, each shifted slightly forward in time, are stacked side by side into an image ( Naiman et al., 2024 ) . Because windows overlap, each feature of the signal traces a diagonal line across the image: periodicity appears as parallel stripes, trends as smooth gradients, and local events as isolated streaks (Figure 3(b) ). Temporal structure thus becomes visual texture that pretrained vision encoders can readily perceive.
blocks.zh: 延迟嵌入 (Takes,2006年)通过本地历史描述一个时间序列:相互重叠的窗口,每扇窗口在时间上稍稍向前移动,并叠成一幅图像(Naiman等人,2024年)。 由于窗口重叠,信号的每个特征都追踪到横跨图像的对角线:周期显示为平行条纹,趋势显示为平滑梯度,局部事件显示为孤立的曲折(图3(b)). 因此,时间结构变成了视觉纹理,预先训练的视觉编码器很容易察觉到。

blocks.en: Both streams enter the language model in the same way. For each time series, 𝐙 i plot \mathbf{Z}_{i}^{\mathrm{plot}} and 𝐙 i delay \mathbf{Z}_{i}^{\mathrm{delay}} occupy separate visual spans, each framed by <|vision_start|> and <|vision_end|> tokens, alongside the textual query Q Q , so the two views interact within a single autoregressive language model rather than through separate heads or an ensemble. Beyond this input-level fusion, we extend DeepStack to the delay stream. Following the DeepStack mechanism of Qwen3-VL ( Meng et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , the three multi-level features of each stream are added directly to the hidden states of the first three language-model layers, one feature per layer, at the positions of that stream’s own visual tokens. blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: Following the staged training paradigm common in multimodal language models and recent TSLMs ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Langer et al., 2026 ) , we train our model, initialized from Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , in two stages that separate the alignment of the new delay stream from task-level instruction tuning. In Stage I (modality alignment) , the Qwen3-VL vision encoder and the language model remain frozen, and we train LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on DINOv3 together with the projection M ( 0 ) M^{(0)} , which maps the final DINOv3 patch features to delay tokens, and the projections { M ( i ) } i = 1 3 \{M^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{3} , which map the intermediate DINOv3 features to the multi-level DeepStack features. This stage is trained on captioning data, encouraging the delay stream to produce representations that the frozen language model can interpret. In Stage II (instruction tuning) , the DINOv3 adapters are merged, the entire visual pathway is frozen, and LoRA is applied to the language model, which is trained on time-series question answering to reason jointly over both views. Both stages use the standard next-token prediction loss computed over the answer tokens only. The objective and hyperparameters are given in Appendix B.2 .

blocks.en: 4 Training Data
blocks.zh: 4 培训数据

blocks.en: We construct a dedicated training corpus for each of the two stages described in Section 3.4 . Stage I uses caption supervision to align the new delay-embedding stream with the language model, whereas Stage II uses a heterogeneous instruction corpus to train perception, numerical readout, forecasting, and temporal reasoning. Most time series are generated procedurally, with labels obtained directly from generator parameters or exact functions of the realized signal rather than from a teacher model. The only real-world time-series sources are CaTS-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) in Stage I and a small subset of sports win-probability series from GAMETime ( Tan et al., 2025 ) used for abductive reasoning in Stage II. Table 2 summarizes the data composition.

supervision.

The instruction corpus contains 182,815 examples spanning complementary task families. We include the released ChatTS ift and sft training sets ( Xie et al., 2025 ) for open-ended univariate and multivariate question answering. Using our TimeSeriesExam fork, we further generate the TSExam perception set, 20,640 multiple-choice questions covering pattern recognition, anomaly detection, similarity, noise, and causality, together with an 11,000-example numerical corpus of open-ended questions whose answers are exact statistics or dynamical quantities computed from the
realized series. The largest component is an in-house 100,000-example reasoning corpus designed to develop broad reasoning capabilities over time series. It spans numerical, deductive, inductive, abductive, causal, etiological, temporal-relation, forecasting, and event-prediction tasks, with examples generated from procedural rules, dynamical systems, and domain-specific simulators. Because instruction-tuned models are sensitive to the task interface, we align the

For all in-house synthetic data, supervision is derived from known generative
parameters or exact computations on the realized signal. Captions describe

generating mechanism, numerical targets are exact signal reductions, and

The TSExam perception set, structural captions, and numerical corpus are generated with our fork of the public generator and contain freshly sampled series whose lengths differ from those in the benchmark.
Similarly, although the reasoning corpus covers the reasoning task families
and question–answer formats evaluated by TSRBench, all training instances
are generated independently and no benchmark examples are used for training.
We additionally verified the reasoning corpus against the benchmark for exact
series overlap, shared sports-game instances, and exact question–answer
matches. ChatTS evaluation data are likewise excluded; only the released
training splits are used. Additional generator details, per-task statistics,
target formats, and held-out splits are provided in
Appendix D .

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on three benchmarks that together probe time-series understanding from low-level perception to high-level reasoning. TSRBench ( Yu et al., 2026a ) , our primary benchmark, comprises 4,125 multiple-choice questions over 15 tasks spanning Perception, Reasoning, Prediction, and Decision-Making. TSExam ( Cai et al., 2024 ) contains 746 multiple-choice questions on pattern recognition, noise understanding, anomaly detection, similarity, and causality, and ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2025 ) measures both fine-grained categorical and numerical alignment and higher-level reasoning over univariate and multivariate series. We compare against two families of models. General-purpose vision-language models receive the series as line plots: Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , our own backbone, isolates the effect of our design and training, while GPT-5 serves as a substantially larger proprietary reference rather than a size-matched competitor. We further compare against representative dedicated TSLMs: ChatTS-14B ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , TS-Reasoner-7B ( Yu et al., 2026b ) , and TimeOmni-1-7B ( Guan et al., 2026 ) . Table 3 reports task-level TSRBench accuracy together with our representation ablations,
and Figure 1 summarizes performance across all three benchmarks.
Complete task-level results and evaluation procedures, including the source of each baseline result, are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 5.2 Do Complementary Representations Improve Temporal Reasoning?
blocks.zh: 5.2 补充说明是否改善时间原因?

blocks.en: Our central hypothesis is that exposing the language model to complementary representations provides benefits that cannot be obtained from either view alone. We therefore compare the full dual-view model against Plot-only and Delay-only variants, as well as two same-view controls that retain the complete dual-tower architecture but feed both towers the same representation. In Plot+Plot , the DINOv3 tower receives the line plot in place of the delay map; in Delay+Delay , the Qwen3-VL tower receives the delay map in place of the line plot. Both controls keep the same encoders, adapters, per-tower token budgets, and two-stage training procedure as our model, so any difference from the full model reflects whether the two streams carry distinct or identical views, rather than differences in architecture or capacity. Table 3 reports results across all 15 TSRBench tasks, together with representative dedicated TSLMs and general-purpose models.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心假设是,将语言模式暴露于互补的表述中,提供了不能仅从两种观点获得的好处。 因此,我们比较了完全双视模式和只限Plot和Delay的变体,以及两个相同视角的控制,它们保留了完整的双塔建筑,但为两塔提供相同的代表. 在 Plot+Plot 中,DINov3 塔接收到代替延迟图的线段图;在 Dray+Delay 中,Quen3-VL 塔接收代替线段图的线段图. 两种控制都保留着与我们的模型相同的编码器,适配器,每塔标价预算,以及两阶段培训程序,因此与完整模型的任何区别都反映了这两条流是否包含不同或相同的观点,而不是结构或容量的差异. 表3报告的结果涉及所有15个TSR Bench任务,以及具有代表性的专门TSLM和通用模型。

blocks.en:
The results show that the benefit of complementary representations is concentrated beyond basic perception. Plot only already achieves 87.4% on Perception, and adding the delay view leaves this essentially unchanged at 86.4%. In contrast, the dual-view model improves Reasoning from 35.8% to 40.1%, Prediction from 38.0% to 61.7%, and Decision-Making from 36.4% to 37.6%, raising overall accuracy from 45.2% to 53.2% . The task-level results further show that the contribution of the complementary
view varies across tasks, rather than producing a uniform improvement across the benchmark. Importantly, simply duplicating a view does not reproduce the gain: Plot+Plot reaches 44.8% overall and Delay+Delay reaches 42.6%, compared with our 53.2%. This suggests that the improvement is not explained merely by providing a second visual stream, but is associated with combining representations that preserve different properties of the underlying signal.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,补充表述的好处集中在基本认知之外。 在Perception上只实现了87.4%,加上延迟视图后,这个比例基本没有变化,为86.4%。 与此相反,双景模型的改进率从35.8%提高到40.1%,预测率从38.0%提高到61.7%,决策率从36.4%提高到37.6%,总体准确率从45.2%提高到53.2%。 任务层面的成果进一步表明,补充性成果的贡献
观点因任务而异,而不是在基准方面产生统一的改进。 重要的是,仅仅重复一个视图并不能复制收益:Plot+Plot总体达到44.8%,Play+Delay达到42.6%,而我们为53.2%。 这表明这种改进不仅仅通过提供第二个视觉流来解释,而是与保留基础信号不同特性的表达方式的结合有关.

blocks.en: Our model also exceeds the evaluated dedicated TSLMs, whose strongest overall TSRBench result is 36.7%. For context, Table 3 additionally reports GPT-5 results; these models are substantially larger proprietary systems and are therefore not size-matched comparisons. They nevertheless provide a useful reference point: our model reaches 53.2% overall, surpassing GPT-5 with visual input (52.4%) and approaching GPT-5 with text and visual input (55.6%), while exhibiting a markedly different task-level performance profile.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型也超过了被评价的专用TSLM,其最强的总TSR奔驰结果为36.7%. 就背景而言,表3还报告了GPT-5结果;这些模型是大得多的专利系统,因此不是大小匹配的比较。 尽管如此,它们仍提供了一个有用的参考点:我们的模型总体达到53.2%,超过GPT-5的视觉输入(52.4%),接近GPT-5的文字和视觉输入(55.6%),同时表现出明显不同的任务级别性能概况。

blocks.en: 5.3 How Do the Representations Respond to Distribution Shifts?
blocks.zh: 5.3 代表机构如何应对分配转移?

blocks.en: To directly probe the inductive biases induced by the visual representations, we apply controlled transformations to TSRBench inputs at evaluation time. We consider affine changes to amplitude and offset, observational noise and smoothing, and changes in sampling horizon. Tasks whose gold targets depend intrinsically on absolute coordinate values or sampling rates are excluded from this analysis, leaving 2,020 items across invariant reasoning, perception, and event prediction tasks. Table 4 reports the resulting accuracy under each transformation, together with clean performance for reference.

The interventions reveal distinct rather than uniformly superior robustness profiles. Consistent with its per-series normalization, the delay-only representation is nearly invariant to the measured affine transformations:
its clean accuracy of 44.7% changes only slightly under rescaling and offset shifts. Our model remains sensitive to affine transformations because its
line-plot stream continues to encode the observed measurement frame, while maintaining substantially higher absolute accuracy than Plot only across all
reported interventions. Its sensitivity also depends on the type of shift: noise and smoothing degrade both Plot only and our model, whereas our model
changes relatively little under changes in sampling horizon. Thus, combining the two views does not impose a single invariance
profile or provide uniform robustness to every perturbation. Instead, the results support the intended representational distinction: the views exhibit
different sensitivities, allowing the model to retain access to the original measurement frame while also incorporating a representation that factors out

blocks.en: 5.4 Cross-Benchmark Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.4 双本标记通用

blocks.en:
Finally, we evaluate whether the gains observed on TSRBench transfer to benchmarks emphasizing different aspects of time-series understanding. Figure 1 summarizes overall TSExam accuracy, categorical and numerical alignment on the univariate (A) and multivariate (B) ChatTS datasets, and TSRBench overall accuracy; per-task results and ChatTS reasoning evaluations are in Appendix C .
Our model attains 89.9% accuracy on TSExam, exceeding the compared general-purpose and dedicated TSLM baselines. On ChatTS, it achieves 80.5% numerical accuracy on univariate sequences and 86.8% on multivariate sequences, with the largest advantage appearing in the multivariate setting. Together with the TSRBench results, these evaluations indicate that the benefit of the dual representation is not confined to a single benchmark: the model remains strong across perceptual, numerical, and broader temporal reasoning tasks, despite using a Qwen3-VL-8B backbone.
blocks.zh:

我们的型号达到了 89.9%的TSExam精度,超过了比较的通用和专用TSLM基线. 在ChatTS上,它在单变量序列上实现了80.5%的数值精度,在多变量序列上实现了86.8%,最大优势出现在多变量设定中. 与TSR Bench结果一起,这些评价表明,双重代表制的好处并不限于一个单一的基准:尽管使用了Qune3-VL-8B主干线,但模型在概念、数字和更广泛的时间推理任务方面仍然很强。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Time-series reasoning requires both numerical readout and understanding of temporal dynamics, yet these capabilities favor different representational properties. This tension motivated our central question: can complementary representations improve general-purpose time-series reasoning? We establish complementary representation as a design principle for TSLMs and instantiate it in a dual-view model that integrates measurement-preserving line plots and normalized delay embeddings through dedicated visual encoders and a shared language model. The resulting model raises TSRBench accuracy from 45.2% for the plot-only variant to 53.2%, surpassing all evaluated dedicated TSLMs. The gains are concentrated beyond basic perception and are not reproduced when both encoders receive line plots or both receive delay embeddings. The model also leads the evaluated baselines on TSExam and multivariate ChatTS numerical alignment, achieving 89.9% and 86.8% accuracy, respectively, demonstrating strong performance across perceptual, numerical, and broader temporal reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 时间序列推理既需要数字读出,也需要对时间动态的理解,然而这些能力偏爱不同的代表属性. 这种紧张促使我们提出中心问题:补充性陈述能否改进通用时间序列推理? 我们确立互补代表作为TSLMs的设计原则,并在双视模型中即时进行,该模型通过专用的视觉编码器和共享的语言模型,将测量保留线图和正常的延迟嵌入. 由此形成的模型将TSR Bench精度从仅用于地块变体的45.2%提高到53.2%,超过了所有被评价的专用TSLM. 收益集中在基本感知之外,当两个编码器都收到行图或两个都收到延迟嵌入时,则不复制。 该模型还领先于TSExam和多变量ChatTS数值对齐的被评价基线,分别达到89.9%和86.8%的准确度,显示出在感知、数字和更广泛的时间推理任务方面的强性。

blocks.en: The STFT comparison in Appendix C.5 further shows that the preferred secondary representation varies across evaluations: delay embeddings perform better on TSRBench, while STFT provides small advantages on ChatTS numerical alignment and average reasoning accuracy. This suggests that representation choice should reflect the capabilities a model must support. The intervention analysis likewise distinguishes access to an invariant view from invariance of the combined model, which retains both normalized structure and absolute measurements. Future work could explore additional representations and encoder combinations, including more than two views and query-dependent mechanisms for combining them.
blocks.zh: 附录C.5中的STFT比较进一步显示,首选的二级代表评价因评价而异:延迟嵌入在TSR Bench上表现较好,而STFT则为ChatTS数值对齐和平均推理准确性提供了小优点. 这表明,代表性选择应反映一种模式必须支持的能力。 干预分析同样区分了对不常态观点的获取和对合并模型的不常态,该模型既保留了常态结构和绝对度量. 今后的工作可以探索更多的表述和编码器组合,包括两种以上的观点和基于查询的合并机制。

blocks.en: C.6 Visual-Token Budget and Same-View Controls
blocks.zh: C.6 视盘预算和视盘控制

blocks.en: For each input series, the line-plot representation is encoded by the native Qwen3-VL vision encoder into 230 visual tokens, while the delay representation contributes 64 visual tokens, for a total of 294 visual tokens per series in the full model. The Plot+Plot and Delay+Delay controls preserve this budget and the complete dual-tower architecture, changing only the input to one tower. In Plot+Plot , the DINOv3 tower receives the line plot, rasterized at 256 × 256 256\times 256 px, in place of the delay map, yielding 64 tokens. In Delay+Delay , the Qwen3-VL tower receives the delay map rendered at approximately 480 × 480 480\times 480 px, yielding approximately 230 tokens, with the embedding window scaled so that its geometry matches the 256 256 -px DINOv3 input. Each control is trained from its own Stage I alignment followed by Stage II instruction tuning, using the same data and hyperparameters as our model. The controls are therefore matched to the full model in architecture, trainable parameters, visual-token budget, and training procedure, and differ only in whether the two towers receive distinct or identical views. They are not matched to the single-view variants, which use one tower and fewer visual tokens. Notably, Delay+Delay allocates substantially more tokens to the delay representation than our model does, and Plot+Plot allocates more tokens to the line plot, yet neither reproduces the gain of the complementary pair, indicating that the improvement cannot be attributed to additional capacity devoted to either view alone.

Plot+Plot和Delay 控件保留了此预算和完整的双塔架构,只将输入改为一个塔. 在Plot+Plot中,DINOv3塔接收线形图案,光栅化为256×256256\times 256px,取代延迟图案,产生64个令牌. 在Delay+Delay中,Quen3-VL塔接收了在大约480×480\times 480px上渲染的延迟图,产生约230个令牌,嵌入窗口缩放,使其几何学与256256-px DINOv3输入相匹配. 每个控制器都从自己的第一阶段对齐,然后是第二阶段指令调制,使用与我们的模型相同的数据和超参数。 因此,控制与建筑、可训练参数、可视化预算和培训程序方面的完整模型相匹配,仅在两个塔获得不同或相同观点方面有所不同。 它们与单景变体不匹配,单景变体使用一个塔和较少的视觉符号. 值得注意的是,“延迟+延迟”比我们的模型和“绘图+”为延迟表示分配的符号要多得多。 Plot为线条图案分配了更多的符号,然而两者都没有复制互补对子的增益,表明改进不能归因于将额外的容量专门用于任何一景.

blocks.en: This section provides the composition and sampling procedure of the data used in the two training stages. Stage I aligns the complementary visual representations with the language-model representation space using descriptive time-series supervision. Stage II performs instruction tuning over a mixture of time-series understanding, numerical, and reasoning tasks. We distinguish throughout between the number of examples available in each source ( raw examples ) and the number sampled during one training epoch ( effective draws ), since several sources are explicitly rebalanced.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍两个培训阶段所用数据的构成和取样程序。 第一阶段利用描述性时间序列监督,使辅助视觉表现与语言模型表现空间保持一致。 第二阶段通过时间序列理解、数字和推理等多种任务来进行指令调整。 我们从头到尾地区分每个来源提供的实例(原始实例)和在一个培训阶段(有效抽签)中抽样的实例,因为若干来源被明确重新平衡。

blocks.en: Table 17 summarizes the datasets used in both training stages. Stage I contains 55,696 raw examples drawn from three captioning sources. Because these sources differ substantially in size, we sample them with equal probability at the source level, such that each contributes one third of the effective Stage-I distribution. We draw 55,696 examples per epoch and train for three epochs.
